description: Help a customer reschedule an appointment. Preserve the original appointment if the change fails. Ask for the appointment ID and desired time only if not supplied. Do not claim success without a successful tool result.

tools.name: get_appointment
tools.description: Read the current appointment and its version.

tools.name: find_slots
tools.description: Find available slots for a date. Availability can change before rescheduling.

tools.name: reschedule
tools.description: Atomically reschedule to a slot using the current appointment version. A version conflict or unavailable slot leaves the original unchanged. A transport timeout does not establish success or failure; read the appointment before retrying.
